objective: Assemble and verify all nine release gates for one exact commit, then stop for explicit approval before immutable tag and release publication.
verification_requirements: Bind fresh passed evidence for tests, test-database migrations, security scans, benchmark subset, CLI, API, clean install, upgrade, and changelog.
Bind every result to the exact release commit with a command, exit code, run reference, artifact hash, timestamp, and bounded evidence.
Confirm the version tag is absent and GitHub immutable releases are enabled before reporting ready_to_tag.
Do not create, overwrite, push, or publish a tag or release from this unbound template; require separate explicit release approval.
